name: The Prey's Prey
overview: Energetic lady Ning Yue's father sends her to the bed of his creditor, the 27-year-old CEO Jiang Ye. The seemingly meticulously planned honey trap turns out to be a scheme orchestrated by the cunning and domineering Ye, who goes along with the plan, coercing and enticing Ning's father while playing the innocent victim in front of the oblivious Yue. Ultimately, he succeeds in leading this stubborn and righteous young woman into marriage.
